answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Each submission hangs on the signal of a task receipt, and the dawn is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the wander of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
